scope: Descriptive within-scene C/G/S pilot after stable complete operation; no statistical superiority or study-completion claim.

arms.G: Existing coverage plus measured-surface/generic geometry score
arms.S: Existing geometry score plus declared category prior

contrasts.C_vs_G: Increment from existing measured-surface/generic geometry terms
contrasts.G_vs_S: Category-conditioned scoring contrast with shared frozen perception/candidate pipeline
contrasts.C_vs_S: Combined package contrast; not semantic-only attribution

design.order_rule: Reverse the complete order in block2; each pairwise preceding/following relation is reversed. Freeze before outcomes; do not choose the order after observing results.
design.balance_limit: Two blocks cannot balance all three absolute positions. G remains middle in this proposed sequence; descriptive pilot only, not a fully position-balanced design.
design.experimental_units: One scene, two related blocks and six episodes; frames, actions and checkpoints are not independent scene samples.

common_contract.policy: Freeze one disclosed implementation/source/configuration manifest for all arms before execution; score mode is the intended arm difference.
common_contract.decision_rules: Retain original declared circle, candidates, scoring terms/weights, stopping rules and return contract; any newly approved variant must be named and common to all arms, not silently substituted.
common_contract.protection: Same ROS collision avoidance and hardware stop protection; record interventions separately.
common_contract.sensor_inputs: Same frozen Nov06 mount TF, declared floor reference, sensor settings, semantic prompts/model and navigation configuration; exact source receipts to be bound before freeze.

initialization.physical_start: Predefine common physical start and heading and use the same placement/capture procedure for every arm.

pose_tolerance.purpose: Experimental placement/reporting convention only; no new online planner or motion gate. Record actual XY/yaw errors and retain existing native anchor legality checks.

initialization.research_state: Fresh mapper, paid-action ledger and semantic/quality history for each episode; no preceding-arm evidence leakage.
initialization.navigation_state: Fresh independent experiment gmapping/costmaps under identical initialization procedure; do not require bitwise-identical particles, SLAM internals or maps.
initialization.coordinate_frame: Common fixed planning transform/ROI registration; grid-from alone establishes coordinates, not identical initial belief.
initialization.capture: Same predeclared no-motion first-capture procedure; preserve each actual initial packet and source stamps.
record_initial: Initial known-mask XOR on common grid
Quality support count/hash and label support
initialization.strict_information_control: Reserve exact same packet/map/support comparisons for offline mechanism replay; this does not block physical pilot execution.

common_ROI.requirement: Choose and freeze a common physical region/registration and evaluator before execution; do not crop by final outcomes.

primary_descriptive_outputs: Actual paid actions, verified arrivals, elapsed time and original CAN travel
Observed coverage proxy versus paid actions and CAN cost on common ROI
Initial-to-final observed-area changes with initial-mask differences disclosed
evaluation.surface_outputs: Per-arm bootstrap-fixed support changes are internal diagnostics; unequal supports are not a matched reconstruction-quality reference.
evaluation.semantic_mechanism: Audit same-state G/S scores, candidate ranking, incremental aperture and prior factors; a positive detector label alone is not semantic task benefit.
evaluation.failures: Retain all starts and failures. Report unequal completed exposure; shorter failed runs are not efficiency wins. No result-dependent reruns, exclusions or budget changes.
evaluation.inference_limit: Descriptive within-scene system performance and preliminary repeatability only. No sufficient statistical superiority, cross-scene generalization or independent reconstruction accuracy.

before_freeze: Complete stable operation and timing/cleanup validation under a fixed implementation
Select common ROI source and evaluator
Document physical placement convention and bind sensor/configuration/source receipts
Verify C/G/S preparation interface: engine score modes support C/G/S, historical prepare_capture.py arm parser accepts C/S only; review any preparation-only extension before freeze
Freeze protocol/order and failure/interruption accounting before the first pilot motion
